title: Chord symbols
description: Five `_x.mnxLab.harmonies` over two bars, drawn from their structure: D, A7/C♯ (a slash bass, spelt with a real sharp), Bm7b5 (the quality suffix keeps its letters, as charts print it), N.C. (quality `none`), and one with a `text` override — E♭Δ7 — shown as written. Each sits just above the staff over its own column; the tempo mark on bar 1 stacks ABOVE the first chord because a player reads the chord with the notes (core-chord-symbols.md, the rendering half).
